entities.name: Mouse OAS2 (E9Q9A9)
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Mus musculus 2'-5'-oligoadenylate synthase 2 (OAS2).
Interferon-induced, dsRNA-activated enzyme that synthesizes 2'-5'-linked oligoadenylates from ATP; products activate RNase L.

entities.name: OAS2 ATP oligomerization
observations: Rhea RHEA:34407: 3 ATP produce 5'-triphosphoadenylyl-(2'->5')-adenylyl-(2'->5')-adenosine and 2 diphosphate; the product is a representative 2-5A oligomer.
